artifacts.summary: Implementation summary for all 15 phases: the L^open proof system, its soundness, both conservativity directions, the deterministic collapse, the measured axiom profiles and the five plan deviations.
Final per-phase handoff: the four repaired gate findings, the one open non-attributable C16 finding, the batch-gate deferral record, and the three load-bearing facts a successor needs.

completion_data.completion_summary: Built the L^open proof system end to end: a closed 71-constructor OpenAxiom, the seven-rule OpenDerivationTree, the eraseOpen retraction with a 71-arm wildcard-free discharge table, two wildcard-free 71-arm validity dispatches, soundness at every frame class, conservativity over TM-plus in both directions (unconditional and syntactic) and over TM at all four classes, and the collapse under Determined recovering the landed deterministic completeness. Eight new Lean files, sorry-free, zero new axioms, every axiom profile measured and no wider than the semantic half it lifts. No completeness is claimed for L^open at any frame class.
